method: Python 3 selected exact prefixes from full-pass5 metadata, summed body bytes/instructions, and decoded all selected ranges using Capstone 4.0.2 x86-32. An indirect transfer is CALL or JMP whose first operand is a register or memory operand.

target_provenance.0x0017c218: continuous-review-20260920-176: callback supplied through second stack argument by sole direct caller

limit: Exact prefix selection is not a complete subsystem or alias/type inventory. It excludes non-export code, differently named VM-adjacent functions, indirect/computed callers, runtime table state/overwrite, ABI semantics, and lifetime.
